description: A pragmatic, property-graph subset of the OMG Knowledge Discovery Metamodel (KDM, ISO/IEC 19506) used as an open-source stand-in for the TCS MasterCraft inventory schema. Every node/edge type records its KDM origin and its expected MasterCraft counterpart so the move to the TCS environment is a remapping, not a redesign.

Program.description: A compilation/deployment unit holding business logic (COBOL program, Java class).

Function.description: A callable unit of business logic (paragraph/section, method).

Screen.description: A user-interface element (BMS map, ACCEPT/DISPLAY dialog, view).

Copybook.description: A shared data structure included by programs (copybook, header, shared schema).

DataStore.description: A persistent data container (indexed/sequential file, DB table, queue).

Job.description: A batch job / scheduler step that executes programs (JCL job).

Handler.description: An entry point reacting to an external event (transaction, controller, event handler).

READS_FROM.description: Code reads from a data store.

WRITES_TO.description: Code writes to a data store.

USES_COPYBOOK.description: Program depends on a shared data structure.

SCREEN_CALLS_PROGRAM.description: A UI element drives a backend program.

JOB_RUNS_PROGRAM.description: A batch job executes a program.

HANDLES_EVENT.description: A handler responds to an event/transaction.

MAPS_TO_TARGET.description: A source component maps to a modern target component (populated in Phase 3).

evidence_contract.rationale: Generated functional specs must trace every assertion to source evidence. Deterministic extractions carry high confidence; inferred ones are flagged so they can be distinguished from facts.
